name: Avea Robotics
long_description: We built the fastest software to control robots from anywhere in the world. We make it possible for robotics companies to keep their robots at 100% uptime, and intervene instantly when a failure occurs.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Ary is the co-founder and CEO of Avea Robotics. His mission is to accelerate the future of autonomous robotics by getting robots out of the lab and into the field.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: Co-founder of Avea Robotics, building high-performance, low-latency software for modern robots. Aerospace + embedded software engineer from UIUC; previously wrote flight software for NASA and DoD satellites. Interested in robotics, physical AI, infrastructure, composite materials, and the state of the world.

launches.title: Avea Robotics - The human-in-the-loop system for robots
launches.tagline: Remote teleop intervention to keep your robots at 100% uptime
launches.body:
Hi! We’re Ary and Vikram. We graduated from UIUC and moved to SF last summer with a mission to get robots out of the lab and into the field, doing real work. Now, we’re at 18k MRR and helped deploy nearly 30 robots!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102363&key=user_uploads/2215628/e3932dd6-69d1-46d6-b42c-568c050068b4)

**What’s the problem?**

Robots aren't perfect- they make mistakes and get stuck in edge cases. That means lost time, and on a factory floor or inside a logistics warehouse, that can translate to thousands of lost dollars. Keeping on-site staff on standby just to babysit them kills ROI and the deployment.

**What’s the solution?**

Our product, Sentinel, allows operators to remotely teleop their robots so they can intervene and keep robots running at 100% uptime. Our software is ultra low-latency, meaning operators can react to the environment in near real-time.

With Sentinel, robotics companies can unlock the path to scaling their deployments.

**Launch Video: [https://youtu.be/dKEbWlZocJQ](https://youtu.be/dKEbWlZocJQ)**

**Our take:** Robotic AI models will never get better if they just sit in the lab. Deployments are the bottleneck for autonomous robots; that’s why we’re building Avea! 

**Asks:** We want to talk to more robotics companies! If you or someone you know is an operator at a robotics company that uses teleoperation, please reach out.

launches.title: Avea Robotics - Control robots from ANYWHERE in the world
launches.tagline: Ultra low-latency VR teleoperation to help you scale your robots.
launches.body:
**TLDR;** Avea builds ultra low-latency teleop software that allows robotics companies to remotely control their robots using VR headsets.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101616&key=user_uploads/2215628/66a8757b-ba8a-4a6c-b573-688aba5ad815)

**What’s the problem?**

When autonomous robots get stuck during deployment, teleoperation is used to recover them and capture that edge case. Today, that means keeping on-site staff on standby just to babysit deployments. It’s not scalable and hurts ROI, causing deployments to stall.

Other remote teleop softwares are clunky and unreliable for real-time control.

**What’s the solution?**

Sentinel allows operators to remotely teleop their robots so they can intervene when autonomy breaks down. Our software has ultra low-latency, meaning operators can react to the environment in near real-time. 

With Sentinel, robotics companies can unlock the path to scaling their deployments.

**Demo Video: [https://youtu.be/dKEbWlZocJQ](https://youtu.be/dKEbWlZocJQ)**

**A bit about us:**

* We moved to SF right after graduating from UIUC last year to work on Avea
* We’ve been doing robotics since high school (shoutout FIRST!)
* We're on a mission to get robots out of the lab and into the real world

**Asks:** We want to talk to more robotics companies! If you or someone you know is an operator at a robotics company, please reach out.
